runner: Existing node:test and Playwright; Windows source packaging command
environment: This Windows PC; pure Node checks may run while Core builds. Browser, fixture and Cargo/archive work wait for Core own Job termination. CI is additional packaging evidence.

cases.scenario: Verify valid SRI, reject changed bytes, unsupported SRI and weaker-hash downgrade
cases.entryPoint: verifyIntegrity used by package and restore commands
cases.expectedBehavior: Only matching strongest supported integrity is accepted
cases.oracle: Known SHA256 abc vector; separately computed SHA512; tampered bytes must throw
cases.sensitivityReason: New verification boundary; explicit negative and algorithm downgrade cases; no previous product behavior to delete for RED

cases.scenario: Check current and future release licensing, legacy MIT preservation and resources
cases.expectedBehavior: AGPL metadata and distributed notices agree; original MIT permission remains
cases.oracle: User 2.0.0 and all later AGPL; canonical license and original MIT notice
cases.sensitivityReason: License text and package-resource inspection; mechanical deletion mutation not needed

cases.scenario: Open settings license dialog, read local text, activate versioned source link, close and restore focus
cases.expectedBehavior: Keyboard and pointer access to notice and exact release; native opener only on explicit activation
cases.oracle: Visible AGPL, copyright, warranty and source text; requested URL equals the package version release
cases.sensitivityReason: New user flow tested through DOM/IPC boundary; native OS browser launch excluded

cases.scenario: Build the exact source archive, restore its dependency cache through real Windows npm argv without literal quotes, and build frontend offline
cases.expectedBehavior: Exact commit, Cargo sources, all locked npm sources, licenses and scripts present; npm offline install and build succeed
cases.oracle: Git revision, Cargo checksum files and npm lock integrity plus actual offline npm restore and frontend build; preserve archive01 DirFetcher failure as RED
cases.sensitivityReason: Archive inspection and real offline rebuild; full native rebuild remains release CI/Core coordination dependent

exclusions: Remote UI is a separately owned component and remains unverified until its implementation and visible offer are checked
